fact: The Bank of Botswana said the National Payments Switch Act, enabling a national retail payments switch, has been drafted and has no tabling date.

The Bank of Botswana licenses electronic payment services: under the amended regulations in force since 2 April 2026 no one may operate one without its licence, on pain of a P1 million fine or five years in prison.

The Bank of Botswana says the Electronic Payment Services (Amendment) Regulations, 2026, in effect since 2 April 2026, set out the entities that may be licensed to offer electronic payment services and the licensing and market-entry requirements.
